description: This Rust source file provides utility functions for atomic file writing, including both synchronous and asynchronous versions, along with associated tests.

methods.name: atomic_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified path atomically by first writing to a temporary file and then renaming it into place.

methods.name: atomic_write_async
methods.description: Asynchronous variant of `atomic_write` using Tokio for async file operations.
